defects: The yard is visibly under-equipped: hanging tools, parts bins, a lathe drive assembly, and workbench-side storage are missing.
incumbent_comparison: Workarea-v003 is the current best valid candidate. Matched run-003/run-001 views show v005 adds a hanging tool set, right-side bins/workbench, and drive wheel while preserving the open center and corrected 23 x 9 x 12 inch footprint.
likely_causes: The repaired footprint branch replaced rather than retained the v2 equipment/detail branch.
next_action_hypothesis: Restore the v2 rack, bins, and lathe parts in the corrected v3 footprint branch; position bins and side storage at the rear/right edge so the activity and construction center stays clear.

observations.art_direction_fit: Timber and iron match the clockwork workshop family, but the sparse contents fall short of a believable working assembly yard.
observations.close_up_quality: At close range, the bench top and one gear are legible, but the missing tool set and bins make the work area feel incomplete.
observations.gameplay_readability: The live production view leaves the activity station and construction staging open; the hoist is presentation-only.
observations.geometric_detail: The run-003 close and three-quarter captures show a gear and rail, but the required tool rack, bins, and complete lathe assembly are absent.
observations.material_realism: The bench wood and iron parts are distinct under production light; the few large flat surfaces remain simple and lightly varied.
observations.proportion: The valid technical bounds match the 23 x 9 x 12 inch envelope and leave the activity station open.
observations.scale_fidelity: The technical report and settlement-scale render show the brief envelope and established 0.6 building scale beside citizens.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The production run-003 view reads as an assembly bench/work pad, but lacks the hanging tools, organized parts bins, and drive assembly specified by the brief.
observations.silhouette_quality: The open slab and single bench dominate the outline; the hoist and work equipment are too sparse to communicate a fully working yard at settlement view.
observations.surface_variation: Pavers and a small set of contrasting materials provide some variation; there are too few purpose-specific details to make the yard appear used.
observations.technical_integration: Godot import/bounds checks pass and run-003 records a production-path candidate render; the visual meshes remain outside gameplay collision/navigation.
